title: Peruvian Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious Peruvian-inspired stir fry made with juicy chicken, nutty quinoa, and sweet dates. This dish is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil and stir in the diced aji amarillo pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sliced dates and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until they start to soften.
Stir in the cooked quinoa and cook for 1-2 minutes until heated through.
Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the quinoa and dates.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
